description: This file declares an interface RoleReadPlatformService responsible for reading role data, including retrieving all roles, active roles, self-service roles, a specific role by ID, and application user roles in the Fineract platform.

classes.name: RoleReadPlatformService
classes.description: An interface defining methods for retrieving role-related data within the user administration service in the Fineract platform.

methods.name: retrieveOne
methods.description: Retrieves a specific role by its ID.

methods.name: retrieveAppUserRoles
methods.description: Retrieves roles associated with a specific application user by user ID.
